name: cognis-vscode
description: Managed Cognis setup for AI semantic search, MCP wiring, and live indexing across MCP-capable editors.

commands.title: Cognis: Connect to AI (MCP Setup Guide)

cognis.pythonPath.description: Optional: use your own Python environment for the Cognis backend. Leave empty to let Cognis install and manage its own backend automatically.

cognis.buyUrl.description: Where the "Buy Cognis" button sends users (e.g. your Polar checkout link). Leave empty to use the project page.

cognis.backendPackageSpec.description: Advanced: override the pip requirement Cognis installs for its backend. Leave empty to install the engine version that matches this extension (recommended; deterministic). Set a value only to pin a specific version, use a mirror, or test a pre-release.

cognis.autoManageOnActivate.description: On activation, inspect the workspace, refresh Cognis config, and let cognis-indexd rebuild or watch as needed.

cognis.autoStartLiveIndexing.description: During auto-manage, start cognis-indexd when the workspace needs indexing or file watching.

cognis.autoIndexOnFileChange.description: When saved files change and live indexing is not running, automatically start cognis-indexd for this workspace.

cognis.promptBeforeMcpWrite.description: Ask once before writing global MCP client configuration during auto-manage.

cognis.autoBootstrapOnOpen.description: Deprecated. Run bootstrap when a workspace opens and .cognis is missing.

cognis.mcpHost.description: MCP config target host. Use auto to detect the current editor.

cognis.pollHealthSeconds.description: Health poll interval when live indexing is active.

cognis.mcpSoftTimeoutSeconds.description: Override COGNIS_MCP_SOFT_TIMEOUT_S in generated MCP config. 0 keeps Cognis defaults; generated Windows configs use a safer automatic value.

cognis.mcpHardTimeoutSeconds.description: Override COGNIS_MCP_HARD_TIMEOUT_S in generated MCP config. 0 keeps Cognis defaults; generated Windows configs use a safer automatic value.

cognis.mcpDiscoverSemanticTimeoutSeconds.description: Override COGNIS_MCP_DISCOVER_SEMANTIC_TIMEOUT_S in generated MCP config. 0 keeps Cognis defaults; generated Windows configs use a safer automatic value.

cognis.mcpSemanticCooldownSeconds.description: Override COGNIS_MCP_SEMANTIC_COOLDOWN_S in generated MCP config. 0 keeps the Cognis default.

cognis.mcpConfigScope.description: Where to write MCP client config. global merges cognis-<repo-slug> entries into ~/.cursor/mcp.json so multiple indexed repos can stay connected at once. workspace writes to .cursor/mcp.json inside the target repository.

cognis.mcpWarmSemanticOnStartup.description: When true, generated MCP config sets COGNIS_MCP_WARM_SEMANTIC_ON_STARTUP=1 so the embedder preloads on MCP server start and avoids first-query timeouts.
